title: Late Charge and Courtesy Waiver Allowances, Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 5 to Tier 1+
content:
This schedule lists the late-charge figures and the courtesy late-charge waiver allowances of each tier of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract.

## Late charge figures

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grace period after an installment due date (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Late charge, percent of the unpaid portion of the installment | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Company maximum late charge per installment before the state maximum (USD) | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Unpaid portion below which no late charge is assessed (USD) | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 |

## Courtesy waiver allowances

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy late-charge waivers allowed in any 12 calendar months (count) | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Installments in a row without a late charge required for a courtesy waiver (count) | 12 | 9 | 9 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

## Reading the allowances

- An allowance of 0, as on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 5, means the tier has no courtesy waivers.
- Tier 1 and Tier 1+ allow 2 courtesy waivers in any 12 calendar months; Tier 4, Tier 3 and Tier 2 allow 1.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* on an unpaid portion of USD 400.00, 5 percent is USD 20.00, which is under the company maximum of USD 30.00.
